messages:
mika: heads up — after the kernel-selector change we see host-side CPU spike on preproc/tokenization. top shows tokenization + grpc small writes up ~3x. profiler snippets below

jon: can you paste the flamegraph snippet or a short profile summary? suspect batching heuristics interaction.

mika: flame summary: token_pool::acquire -> tokenizer::normalize -> http2::write_small -> poll_writev. KV cache miss rate up ~2.1x since the rollout.

sasha: kv miss increase is odd — @lina did the kvcache eviction tweak land yesterday?

lina: i rolled the kvcache LRU adjustment at 01:50 but disabled the aggressive-evict flag for canary at 08:00. metrics looked fine on canary before this. was the kernel change also rolled?

mika: yes kernel-selector started preferring fused-attn-v2 for seq < 128 at 02:10 cluster-wide.

jon: that could shift seq-length distribution and change host-side prefix work. fused kernels can reduce GPU time but increase small host copies for prefix/KV handling.

sasha: quick repro numbers — 1k reqs mean seq 90:
old selector host CPU avg: 35%
new selector host CPU avg: 62%
(measured on same hardware)

mika: reproducer commands i used:
```
./bench --mode=host --model=xl --selector=old --n=1000 > old.out
./bench --mode=host --model=xl --selector=new --n=1000 > new.out
```

deploy-bot: Canary rollout for selector v2 paused at 02:18 due to perf-alert (auto).

jon: :eyes: i'll bisect kernel change with @mika. hypothesis: fused-attn-v2 reduces decode cost but increases prefix copy frequency leading to many small write syscalls.

lina: i'll revert the kvcache eviction tweak in canary to rule it out.

mika: also seeing grpc p99 tail jump from 48ms -> 120ms. trace shows many 1-3 write syscalls per request rather than one coalesced write. we should coalesce small streaming writes at the ingress shim.

sasha: we already have a WIP branch "writev-coalesce-shim" — it needs to be validated with streaming clients. @jon can you wire that into the matrix?

jon: will run streaming-client matrix and measure small write counts + p99.

mika: action items:
- jon + mika: bisect kernel selector and confirm causality (target: 1h)
- lina: revert kvcache tweak in canary (in flight, 30m)
- jon: run writev-coalesce tests against streaming clients and report small-write counts (2h)
please ping this thread with results.

lina: revert pushed to canary, monitoring kv metrics now.

deploy-bot: Canary revert executed successfully, kv miss rate back near baseline.

jon: bisect update: disabling fused-attn-v2 drops host CPU back to ~38%. looks primary.

sasha: good catch. proposed plan: revert selector default, add guard to disallow fused-attn-v2 for requests with heavy prefix/KV interactions until we can coalesce writes and tune batching heuristics.

mika: thanks — i'll open a PR with perf numbers, flame snippets, and the suggested guard. we'll re-evaluate after writev coalesce runs."
